translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Med'inaa Goday Sa'aa Murana
Be'ite, Med'inaa Goday gadiyaa koliide mela kessana; I gadiyaa bayzziide, aan de'iyaa asaakka laalana.

Hara asaa bollan haniyaawaadan k'eesetuwaa bollankka, k'oomaa bollan haniyaawaadan godaa bollankka, k'oomatti bollan haniyaawaadan godatti bollankka, shammiyaawaa bollan haniyaawaadan zal"iyaawaa bollankka, tal"iyaa immiyaawaa bollan haniyaawaadan tal"iyaa akkiyaawaa bollankka, ac'uwaa achchiyaawaa bollan haniyaawaadan, ac'uwaa ashettiyaawaa bollankka hanana.
Biittay ubbaanna mela kesana; k'ay ubbaannakka bonk'k'ettanawaa. Ayaw gooppe, ha k'aalaa Med'inaa Goday haasayeedda.
Biittay loytsi melina, Aa aac'ay ubbay shullee; gadiyaan de'iyaa wolk'k'aama asaykka daaburee.
Biittay barenan de'iyaa asaappe denddeeddawaan tuneedda. Ayaw gooppe, unttunttu higgiyaa koleeddino; wogaa mentseeddino; med'inaa c'aak'uwaakka koleeddino.

Hewaa diraw, S'oossaa shek'ay gadiyaa mee; k'ay aan de'iyaa asatuukka barenttu bayzzuwaa gaasuwaan mureteeddino. Hewaa diraw, sa'aan de'iyaa asatuu s'uugetteeddino; yaatina payduwaan guutsaa Asay atteeda.
Woynniyaa turaa anuu melina, woyniyaa eessaykka wureedda; kase nashetiyaa ubbay kayyotteedda.
Karabuwaa bak'aa nashechchay c'o"u geedda. Nashettiyaawanttu hombboc'etsaykka ek'k'eedda. Lo"iyaa diitsaa nashechchaykka c'o"u geedda.
Hawaappe sintsanaw yetsaa yes's'iid, unttunttu woyniyaa eessaa ushikkino; matsoyiyaa ushshay ushiyaawanttoo c'amo gidanawaa.
Maaraa mac'araa d'ayeedda katamay laaletteedda; ooninne gelennaadan, golliyaa ubbay gorddetteedda.
Woynniyaa eessay d'ayeeddawoo Asay dabaaban waassee; nashechchaa ubbay kayyoo laametteedda; sa'aa nashechchay ubbay kichcheedda.
Katamay koletteedda; katamaa penggetuukka me'eretteeddino.
Wogaraa teeraa k'aatsiide k'ok'k'ofiyaawaadan, woy woyniyaa teeraa mas'i simmiide, k'aarimiyaa mas'iyaawaadan, gadiyaa bollan de'iyaa kawutetsatuwaa giddon hewaadan hanana.
Unttunttu barenttu k'aalaa d'ok'k'u ootsiide, nashshechchan yes's'iino; away wulliyaa baggana de'iyaa ubbay Med'inaa Godaa gitatetsaa odana.

Hewaa diraw, away doliyaa baggana de'iyaawanttoo, Med'inaa Godaw bonchchuwaa immite; abbaa doonaan de'iyaa biittatuwaan de'iyaawanttoo, Israa'eeliyaa Med'inaa Godaa, S'oossaa suntsaw bonchchuwaa immite.

Biittaa gas'aappe, «S'illoo bonchchuu gido» yaagiyaa yetsaa nuuni siseetto. Shin taani, «Taani gilk'k'ay! Taani gilk'k'ay! Taw aayye ana! Ayaw gooppe, kaddiyaawanttuu kaddiino; kaddiyaawanttuu loytsi aatsi immiino» yaagay.
Hinttenoo, sa'aa bollan de'iyaa asatoo, dagamay, aafuunne p'irii hinttena naagee.
Saluwaa maskkootetuu dooyetteedda dirawunne, gadiyaa baasotuukka k'aas's'iyaa diraw, dagantsiyaa kooshshaappe bak'atiyaawe ollaan kunddana; k'ay ollaappe pude kesiyaawe p'iriyaan oyk'k'ettana.
Biittay za"iide p'alk'k'etteedda; nippi giide me'eretteedda; wolk'k'aappe k'aas's'eedda.
Biittay matsottiide asaadan ganddigaaree; c'arkkuu sugiyaa daasiyaadan, yonk'k'u gee. Makkalanchchatuu bayzzuu Aa loytsi dees'eedda diraw, laa"entso denddennaadan kunddee.
He gallassi Med'inaa Goday saluwaa wolk'k'atuwaa saluwaan, k'ay sa'aa kaatetuwaakka sa'aan murana.
Unttunttu ollaan de'iyaa k'asho asatuwaadan, ittippe shiik'ana; k'asho golliyaan gorddettiide uttana. K'ay daro gallassaappe guyyiyaan, unttunttu murettana.

Hewaappe guyyiyaan, aginayikka awaykka yeellatana. Ayaw gooppe, Ubbaappe Wolk'k'aama Med'inaa Goday S'iyoone deriyaaninne Yerusaalamen kaatetana; k'ay I Yerusaalame c'imatuwaa sintsan bare bonchchuwaa k'onc'c'issana.
